title: Clinical Recognition of Frontotemporal Dementia with Right Temporal Predominance; Consensus Recommendations of the International Working Group
authors: Ulugut H; Younes K; Montembeault M; Bertoux M; Irish M; Kumfor F; Fumagalli GG; Samanci B; Illán-Gala I; Thompson JC; Santillo AF; Englund E; Waldö ML; Riedl L; Van den Stock J; Vandenbulcke M; Vandenberghe R; Laforce RJ; Ducharme S; Pressman PS; Caramelli P; de Souza LC; Takada LT; Gurvit H; Diehl-Schmid J; Galimberti D; Pasquier F; Weintraub S; Miller BL; Sturm VE; Whitwell JL; Boeve B; Rohrer JD; Piguet O; Gorno-Tempini ML; Josephs KA; Snowden J; Rowe JB; Warren JD; Rankin KP; Pijnenburg YA
one_liner_zh: 该文为额颞叶痴呆右颞叶优势型的临床诊断共识，纯临床表型与术语规范，无蛋白质-DNA互作、无AI/物理模拟方法，与本课题无关。
abstract: Accurate diagnosis of frontotemporal dementia (FTD) with right anterior temporal lobe (RATL) predominance remains challenging due to lack of clinical characterization, and standardized terminology. The recent research of the International Working Group (IWG) identified common symptoms but also unveiled broad terminologies lacking precision and operationalization, with risk of misdiagnoses, inappropriate referrals and poor clinical management. Based on the published evidence (91267 articles screened) and expert opinion (105 FTD specialists across 52 centers), the IWG delineates three primary domains of impairment causing behavioral, memory and language problems: (i) multimodal knowledge of non-verbal information including people, living beings, landmarks, flavors/odors, sounds, bodily sensations, emotions and social cues; (ii) socioemotional behavior encompassing emotion expression, social response and motivation; and (iii) prioritization for focus on specific interests, hedonic valuation and personal preferences. This study establishes a consensus on clinical profile, phenotypic nomenclature, and future directions to enhance diagnostic precision and therapeutic interventions.
abstract_zh: 前颞叶右侧（RATL）为主的额颞叶痴呆（FTD）的准确诊断仍具挑战性，原因在于缺乏临床特征描述和标准化术语。国际工作组（IWG）的最新研究识别了常见症状，但也揭示了术语广泛却缺乏精确性和操作性，存在误诊、不当转诊及临床管理不善的风险。基于已发表证据（筛选91267篇文章）和专家意见（来自52个中心的105名FTD专家），IWG delineates了导致行为、记忆和语言问题的三个主要损伤领域：（i）非言语信息的多模态知识，包括人物、生物、地标、风味/气味、声音、身体感觉、情绪和社会线索；（ii）社会情感行为，涵盖情绪表达、社会反应和动机；及（iii）对特定兴趣、享乐评价和个人偏好的优先关注。本研究就临床特征、表型命名及未来方向达成共识，以提升诊断精确性和治疗干预效果。
